headline: Seedpin rollout complete — the whole arcade reports and pins
lede: Batch 24 retired the last 13 legacy report shapes, so every title on the board now files feedback in the strict form, 55 honor ?seed=N replays, and the emulator tier reports honest seedless state. Issue #1473 shipped closed.

notes.text: SEEDPIN b24 (PR #1554): all 13 UNSTRICT titles normalized to the strict () => ({ shape — values unchanged, online seeds keep authority; ratchet budget frozen at 0 so any future loose reporter goes RED.
#1473 CLOSED: 83/83 titles report at mount and clean up, 55 replay from a filed seed (?seed=N), 28 lawfully seedless with audited proofs (emulators, fixed worlds, decoration-only RNG).
Mutant proof kept honest: reverting Homebody to its old ternary shape reddened the coverage law + ratchet (228/230) before restore; roguecheck's seed law now proves the strict shape itself.
Board is dry after the rollout — filed jonq #1557 asking Jon for the next milestone; flagship READMEs all hold zero open gaps.
